title: KPSEA and KJSEA Assessment Registration
description: Internal comparison record retained for editorial traceability. Use assessment-specific records for future public answers.
clarifying_questions: Which candidate type, programme or assessment pathway?

claims.text: The 2026 KPSEA/KILEA registration window was 16 February to 16 March 2026; it is historical.
The 2026 KJSEA/KPLEA registration window was 2 March to 31 March 2026; it is historical.
Grade 6 learners require fresh KPSEA registration and an assessment number; missing numbers must be addressed through the Grade 6 portal.
KJSEA registration is not automatic. Requirements include the Grade 9 database entry, KPSEA performance or equivalent, and Grade 7 and 8 school-based assessment scores.
For stage-based KILEA, teachers identify readiness and institutions register learners in the appropriate portal.
For stage-based KPLEA, teachers identify readiness and institutions register learners in the appropriate portal.
The KPSEA institutional declaration verifies candidate names, assessment numbers and subject entries, including special-needs and religious-education options. It is forwarded through the SCDE.

The KPSEA special-needs form requires institutional and medical evidence identifying assistance; its notes specify recent detailed medical and EARC reports for listed categories and a full-size photograph for physical disability. Low-vision candidates also require a medical report.
